title: Physical features
about: Features and outlines come from Natural Earth 1:10m (public domain): marine areas, physical regions, elevation points, lakes and rivers. Outlines of regions such as deserts or mountain ranges are hand-drawn generalisations, so treat their edges as approximate. Waterfalls and glaciers are placed from Wikidata. Which features are included is decided by how widely known they are (number of Wikipedia language editions). Lengths, areas and heights are from Wikidata where available, otherwise measured on the map outline. The short facts were written with Claude from each feature's English Wikipedia article intro (CC BY-SA 4.0).
